description:
X frame banner stands for standout advertising.

X frame banner stands are durable, lightweight, and cost-effective tools for marketing. These stands are reusable and are great for quickly changing banner graphics to show current promotions or safety guidelines.  

The X-banner stands are available in two sizes: 

  • Standard Awesome X (63" x 23.5) 
  • Premium Adjustable Grasshopper X (80” x 36) 

Meanwhile, the banner graphics are available in four sizes: 

  • 24” x 63” (Only fits the Standard Awesome X stand) 
  • 24” x 72” (Fits the Grasshopper X stand) 
  • 36” x 78” (Fits the Grasshopper X stand) 
  • 48” x 84” (Fits the Grasshopper X stand) 

Note: X banner stands come in a bag complete with accessories. Quick assembly required before use.

X Banner Online Printing Services

Custom printing X banners can help you get your message across to the right audience. Set up the banner in places where your customers can easily and quickly see them:   

  • Store entrances 
  • Cash registers 
  • Curbside 
  • Registration tables 
  • Offices  
  • Clinic & hospital lobbies 

 

UPrinting offers X banners in three (3) materials:   

  • 13 oz Smooth Matte Vinyl – waterproof and fade-resistant. Great for indoor and outdoor use. 
  • 18 oz Heavy Duty Vinyl – excellent tensile strength offers the ultimate tear-resistance. Works great even in low temperatures. 
  • UV Fabric – heavy-duty fabric banner. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.

Banners are printed within four (4) business days. You can print up to 10 banners per order. To find out when your banner will ship, click the Estimate Shipping & Delivery link, and enter your zip code.  

 

X Banner FAQs

Banners for X banner stands are printed on one side only. Since the banner will be mounted on an X-frame, your customers will not see the graphics on the other side.

The banners are available in 24" x 63", 24" x 72", 36" x 78", and 48" x 84". This size fits the frame perfectly, so your banner is stretched out without any creasing.

Yes, you can display your banner and stand outdoors where people can easily see them. However, we recommend placing them in non-windy areas as strong winds may topple the stand.

If you want to purchase the most affordable stand and you don't mind that you can only use the 24" x 63" banner graphics, the Standard Awesome X is an excellent option. But if you want to use larger graphics (24" x 72", 36" x 78", and 48" x 84"), the Premium Adjustable Grasshopper X might be a better choice.
